suggestions.rationale: Clinical Mapping Master Batch 2026 publishes this relationship only as phenotype specific disease transformation. Apply only to therapy-related/secondary MDS phenotype consistent with the source and subsequent acute nonlymphocytic/myeloid leukemia transformation. Older source is therapy-related MDS specific; do not generalize this record to all de novo MDS without stronger matching evidence. The cited literature supports only this bounded proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
evidenceGaps: Documentation that Myelodysplastic Syndromes matches the source-specific phenotype or population
Independent diagnosis of Leukemia (Acute & Chronic) with compatible chronology
Assessment of competing medical, treatment-related, behavioral, and demographic contributors
Qualified clinical opinion before applying the population-level relationship to an individual case
